### Validate whole responses with retry

Parse complete model responses atomically when you prefer all-or-nothing validation and self-correcting retries over incremental token streaming.

If the model invents an unknown component, omits `root`, or leaves a dangling child ID, parsing the whole response leaves the session state untouched and raises an `A2uiError` whose message you can feed back to the model on a retry turn:

#### TypeScript

```typescript
import {A2uiError, type A2uiRequestProcessor, type AgentToRendererMessage} from '@a2ui/agent';

export async function generateValidatedTurn(
  processor: A2uiRequestProcessor,
  userPrompt: string,
  callLlm: (prompt: string) => Promise<string>,
  maxRetries = 2,
): Promise<AgentToRendererMessage[]> {
  let prompt = userPrompt;
  for (let attempt = 0; attempt <= maxRetries; attempt++) {
    const rawText = await callLlm(prompt);
    try {
      const parts = processor.parseResponse(rawText);
      const messages: AgentToRendererMessage[] = [];
      for (const part of parts) {
        if (part.type === 'a2ui') {
          messages.push(...part.a2ui);
        }
      }
      return messages;
    } catch (err) {
      if (!(err instanceof A2uiError) || attempt === maxRetries) {
        throw err;
      }
      prompt = [
        userPrompt,
        `Your previous A2UI block failed validation: ${err.message}`,
        'Fix the A2UI output so every component and ID matches the catalog.',
      ].join('\n\n');
    }
  }
  return [];
}
```

#### Python

```python
from collections.abc import Awaitable, Callable

from a2ui.core import A2uiError
from a2ui.core.schema import AgentToRendererMessage
from a2ui.parser import A2uiPart
from a2ui.processor import A2uiRequestProcessor

async def generate_validated_turn(
    processor: A2uiRequestProcessor,
    user_prompt: str,
    call_llm: Callable[[str], Awaitable[str]],
    max_retries: int = 2,
) -> list[AgentToRendererMessage]:
  prompt = user_prompt
  for attempt in range(max_retries + 1):
    raw_text = await call_llm(prompt)
    try:
      parts = processor.parse_response(raw_text)
      return [
          msg
          for part in parts
          if isinstance(part, A2uiPart)
          for msg in part.a2ui
      ]
    except A2uiError as err:
      if attempt == max_retries:
        raise
      prompt = (
          f"{user_prompt}\n\n"
          f"Your previous A2UI block failed validation: {err}\n"
          "Fix the A2UI output so every component and ID matches the catalog."
      )
  return []
```

#### Dart

```dart
import 'package:a2ui_agent/a2ui_agent.dart';
import 'package:a2ui_core/a2ui_core.dart';

Future<List<AgentToRendererMessage>> generateValidatedTurn(
  A2uiRequestProcessor processor,
  String userPrompt,
  Future<String> Function(String prompt) callLlm, {
  int maxRetries = 2,
}) async {
  var prompt = userPrompt;
  for (var attempt = 0; attempt <= maxRetries; attempt++) {
    final rawText = await callLlm(prompt);
    try {
      final parts = processor.parseResponse(rawText);
      return [
        for (final part in parts)
          if (part is A2uiPart) ...part.a2ui,
      ];
    } on A2uiError catch (err) {
      if (attempt == maxRetries) rethrow;
      prompt = '$userPrompt\n\n'
          'Your previous A2UI block failed validation: $err\n'
          'Fix the A2UI output so every component and ID matches the catalog.';
    }
  }
  return const [];
}
```

### Customize catalogs and inference formats

Prune large catalogs to relevant components or customize inference format options on the generator to reduce prompt size and match your model.

Attach component or function pruning transformers to `CatalogConfig` to expose only the widgets a workflow needs, and pass options to `ExpressFormatFactory` or swap to `DirectJsonFormatFactory` when a model emits raw JSON inside `<a2ui-json>` tags (see [Inference Formats](/concepts/inference-formats/)). In Python, you can also compose server-side component templates with `@macro` and `MacroExpander` so clients render new composite layouts without a client release (see [Using Macros](/guides/macros/)):

#### TypeScript

```typescript
import {
  A2uiGenerator,
  CatalogConfig,
  ComponentPruningTransformer,
  DirectJsonFormatFactory,
  ExpressFormatFactory,
} from '@a2ui/agent';
import {basicCatalog} from '@a2ui/web_core/v1_0';

export const formatFactory = new ExpressFormatFactory({
  surfaceId: 'order_summary',
  allowedMessages: ['createSurface', 'updateComponents', 'updateDataModel'],
});

// Or emit raw A2UI JSON inside <a2ui-json> tags:
export const jsonFormatFactory = new DirectJsonFormatFactory({
  progressiveKeys: ['text'],
});

export const prunedGenerator = new A2uiGenerator(
  [
    new CatalogConfig(basicCatalog, [
      new ComponentPruningTransformer(['Card', 'Column', 'Text', 'Button']),
    ]),
  ],
  undefined,
  formatFactory,
);
```

#### Python

```python
from a2ui.catalog_transformers import ComponentPruningTransformer
from a2ui.core.basic_catalog import BasicCatalog
from a2ui.core.schema import ProtocolVersion
from a2ui.inference_formats import DirectJsonFormatFactory, ExpressFormatFactory
from a2ui.processor import A2uiGenerator, CatalogConfig

format_factory = ExpressFormatFactory(
    allowed_messages=["createSurface", "updateComponents", "updateDataModel"],
    surface_id="order_summary",
)

# Or emit raw A2UI JSON inside <a2ui-json> tags:
json_format_factory = DirectJsonFormatFactory(progressive_keys={"text"})

pruned_generator = A2uiGenerator(
    catalogs=[
        CatalogConfig(
            catalog=BasicCatalog(ProtocolVersion.V1_0),
            transformers=[
                ComponentPruningTransformer(["Card", "Column", "Text", "Button"])
            ],
        ),
    ],
    inference_format_factory=format_factory,
)
```

#### Dart

```dart
import 'package:a2ui_agent/a2ui_agent.dart';
import 'package:a2ui_core/a2ui_core.dart';

const formatFactory = ExpressFormatFactory(
  allowedMessages: ['createSurface', 'updateComponents', 'updateDataModel'],
);

// Or emit raw A2UI JSON inside <a2ui-json> tags:
const jsonFormatFactory = DirectJsonFormatFactory(progressiveKeys: {'text'});

final prunedGenerator = A2uiGenerator(
  catalogs: [
    CatalogConfig(
      BasicCatalog.v1_0(),
      transformers: [
        ComponentPruningTransformer(['Card', 'Column', 'Text', 'Button']),
      ],
    ),
  ],
  inferenceFormatFactory: formatFactory,
);
```

---

## Connect to agent frameworks and transports

Plug the A2UI generator and message processors into standard agent frameworks and protocols instead of writing custom transport plumbing.

### Google ADK

Use the ADK integration package to manage per-session request processors, inject A2UI prompt instructions without colliding with ADK `{variable}` state templating, expose the client A2UI toolset, and bridge A2A events and function RPCs:

```bash
pip install "a2ui-adk[a2a]"
```

```python
from google.adk.a2a.executor.a2a_agent_executor import A2aAgentExecutorConfig
from google.adk.agents import LlmAgent

from a2ui.adk import (
    A2uiEventConverter,
    A2uiInstruction,
    A2uiProcessorStore,
    SendA2uiToClientToolset,
    a2ui_rpc_callback,
)

processors = A2uiProcessorStore()

def active_catalogs(ctx):
  processor = processors.get(ctx)
  return processor.active_catalogs if processor else None

order_agent = LlmAgent(
    model="gemini-2.5-flash",
    name="order_agent",
    instruction=A2uiInstruction(
        "You help customers manage pickup orders in {store_city}.",
        a2ui_processor=processors.get,
        a2ui_enabled=processors.is_enabled,
    ),
    tools=[
        SendA2uiToClientToolset(
            a2ui_enabled=processors.is_enabled,
            a2ui_processor=processors.get,
        ),
    ],
    before_agent_callback=a2ui_rpc_callback(catalogs=active_catalogs),
)

executor_config = A2aAgentExecutorConfig(
    event_converter=A2uiEventConverter(a2ui_processor=processors.get),
)

# In your request executor before running the session:
# processors.set(session.id, processor if a2ui_active else None)
```

> **Note**
  ADK substitutes `{name}` placeholders in plain string instructions from session state.
  Concatenating `processor.prompt_snippet` into a raw `LlmAgent.instruction` string raises
  `KeyError` on A2UI braces (such as `${expression}` or `\p{XID_Start}`). Always wrap your
  instruction in `A2uiInstruction`, which resolves your own `{store_city}` template variables while
  leaving the A2UI prompt untouched.

### A2A protocol

Use the A2A integration package to advertise A2UI support on your agent card, negotiate the [A2A Extension Specification](/specification/v1.0-a2ui-extension-specification/) per request, stream A2UI messages as `application/a2ui+json` data parts, and answer inbound function RPCs:

```bash
pip install a2ui-a2a
```

```python
from a2a.server.agent_execution import AgentExecutor, RequestContext
from a2a.server.events import EventQueue
from a2a.types import AgentCapabilities, AgentCard

from a2ui.a2a import (
    create_a2ui_parts,
    get_a2ui_agent_extension,
    get_a2ui_messages,
    stream_response_to_parts,
    try_activate_a2ui_extension,
)
from a2ui.core.basic_catalog import BasicCatalog
from a2ui.core.schema import ProtocolVersion
from a2ui.rpc import RendererToAgentMessageProcessor

basic = BasicCatalog(ProtocolVersion.V1_0)

agent_card = AgentCard(
    name="Order Agent",
    description="Streams interactive order summaries with A2UI.",
    url="http://localhost:10002/",
    version="1.0.0",
    default_input_modes=["text/plain"],
    default_output_modes=["text/plain", "application/a2ui+json"],
    capabilities=AgentCapabilities(
        streaming=True,
        extensions=[
            get_a2ui_agent_extension(
                ProtocolVersion.V1_0,
                supported_catalog_ids=[basic.catalog_id],
            ),
        ],
    ),
    skills=[],
)

class OrderA2aExecutor(AgentExecutor):
  # Given a session processor lookup and an enqueue_parts(event_queue, parts) helper:
  async def execute(
      self, context: RequestContext, event_queue: EventQueue
  ) -> None:
    activated_version = try_activate_a2ui_extension(context, agent_card)
    if activated_version is None:
      return
    processor, token_stream = await self.prepare_session(context)
    inbound = (
        get_a2ui_messages(context.message)
        if context.message is not None
        and activated_version == ProtocolVersion.V1_0
        else []
    )
    rpc_processor = RendererToAgentMessageProcessor(processor.active_catalogs)
    results = [await rpc_processor.process_message(msg) for msg in inbound]
    if inbound and all(result.handled for result in results):
      rpc_reply_parts = create_a2ui_parts(
          [reply for result in results for reply in result.replies],
          version=activated_version,
      )
      if rpc_reply_parts:
        await enqueue_parts(event_queue, rpc_reply_parts)
      return

    async for a2a_part in stream_response_to_parts(
        processor.open_stream(), token_stream, activated_version
    ):
      await enqueue_parts(event_queue, [a2a_part])
```

### AG-UI and CopilotKit

Enable A2UI on `CopilotRuntime` to stream A2UI surfaces over [AG-UI](https://docs.ag-ui.com/) across Python and TypeScript agent backends.

When `injectA2UITool: true` is set (or when the frontend supplies a catalog), CopilotKit injects the A2UI generation tool and translates tool calls and state deltas into AG-UI events across integrations including Google ADK (`ag_ui_adk`), LangGraph (`CopilotKitMiddleware`), and AWS Strands (`@ag-ui/aws-strands`). See the [CopilotKit A2UI documentation](https://docs.copilotkit.ai/generative-ui/a2ui) for runtime setup details:

```typescript
import {CopilotRuntime} from '@copilotkit/runtime';

const runtime = new CopilotRuntime({
  agents: {
    order_agent: myOrderAgent, // Your AG-UI compatible agent instance
  },
  a2ui: {
    injectA2UITool: true, // Optional (default: false)
  },
});
```

For Model Context Protocol tool servers that attach interactive UI resources (`ui://`), see [Serve A2UI Layouts from an MCP Server](/guides/a2ui-over-mcp/) and [MCP Integration Overview](/guides/mcp-overview/).

---

# Authoring Universal Web Components

> Write a custom A2UI Web Component once with A2uiLitElement and register it across Lit, React, and Angular catalogs.

Canonical URL: https://a2ui.org/guides/authoring-universal-components/

Universal components let you write a custom A2UI Web Component once with `A2uiLitElement` and register it directly in Lit, React, and Angular catalogs without per-framework wrappers. You declare the component's property contract with a Zod schema, and `@a2ui/web_core` resolves data bindings, function calls, child references, and actions before passing values to your element.

Install `@a2ui/web_core`, `lit`, and `zod` alongside the renderer package for your host framework (`@a2ui/lit`, `@a2ui/react`, or `@a2ui/angular`):

```bash
npm install @a2ui/web_core lit zod
```

## Step 1: Define the component schema

Create a `ComponentApi` object with the component `name` used in A2UI JSON payloads and a Zod `schema` describing its properties. Use `DynamicStringSchema` so each field accepts either a literal string or a data-model binding (see [Catalogs, Components, and Functions](/concepts/catalogs/) and [How to Define a Catalog](/guides/defining-a-catalog/)).

#### v1.0

```typescript
// stat-card.api.ts
import {z} from 'zod';
import {type ComponentApi} from '@a2ui/web_core';
import {DynamicStringSchema} from '@a2ui/web_core/v1_0';

export const StatCardApi = {
  name: 'StatCard',
  schema: z.object({
    label: DynamicStringSchema,
    value: DynamicStringSchema,
  }),
} satisfies ComponentApi;
```

#### v0.9.1

```typescript
// stat-card.api.ts
import {z} from 'zod';
import {type ComponentApi, DynamicStringSchema} from '@a2ui/web_core/v0_9';

export const StatCardApi = {
  name: 'StatCard',
  schema: z.object({
    label: DynamicStringSchema,
    value: DynamicStringSchema,
  }),
} satisfies ComponentApi;
```

## Step 2: Build the custom element

Extend `A2uiLitElement` parameterized with `typeof StatCardApi`, read resolved values from `this.controller.props`, and export a `WebComponentImplementation` pairing the API with `tagName` and `element`.

HTML custom element `tagName` values such as `'a2ui-stat-card'` require a hyphen under the W3C Custom Elements specification. By contrast, A2UI v1.0 surface component `id` values in JSON payloads must be valid Unicode identifiers ([UAX #31](https://www.unicode.org/reports/tr31/)) such as `'revenue_card'` or `'revenueCard'`, without hyphens.

#### v1.0

```typescript
// stat-card.ts
import {css, html} from 'lit';
import {A2uiLitElement, type WebComponentImplementation} from '@a2ui/web_core/universal';
import {StatCardApi} from './stat-card.api.js';

export class StatCardElement extends A2uiLitElement<typeof StatCardApi> {
  static override styles = css`
    :host {
      display: block;
      padding: 16px;
      border: 1px solid var(--border-color, #e2e8f0);
      border-radius: 8px;
    }
    .label {
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      color: #64748b;
    }
    .value {
      font-size: 1.5rem;
      font-weight: 700;
    }
  `;

  protected override readonly api = StatCardApi;

  override render() {
    const {label, value} = this.controller.props;
    return html`
      <div class="label">${typeof label === 'string' ? label : ''}</div>
      <div class="value">${typeof value === 'string' ? value : ''}</div>
    `;
  }
}

export const statCardComponent: WebComponentImplementation<typeof StatCardApi.schema> = {
  ...StatCardApi,
  tagName: 'a2ui-stat-card',
  element: StatCardElement,
};
```

#### v0.9.1

```typescript
// stat-card.ts
import {css, html} from 'lit';
import {A2uiLitElement, type WebComponentImplementation} from '@a2ui/web_core/v0_9/universal';
import {StatCardApi} from './stat-card.api.js';

export class StatCardElement extends A2uiLitElement<typeof StatCardApi> {
  static override styles = css`
    :host {
      display: block;
      padding: 16px;
      border: 1px solid var(--border-color, #e2e8f0);
      border-radius: 8px;
    }
    .label {
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      color: #64748b;
    }
    .value {
      font-size: 1.5rem;
      font-weight: 700;
    }
  `;

  protected override readonly api = StatCardApi;

  override render() {
    const {label, value} = this.controller.props;
    return html`
      <div class="label">${label}</div>
      <div class="value">${value}</div>
    `;
  }
}

export const statCardComponent: WebComponentImplementation<typeof StatCardApi.schema> = {
  ...StatCardApi,
  tagName: 'a2ui-stat-card',
  element: StatCardElement,
};
```

## Step 3: Register the component in your app

Add `statCardComponent` to a catalog alongside the optional Basic Catalog components (or your own custom component set) and pass that catalog to your framework's renderer. Host renderers register `a2ui-stat-card` in `customElements` automatically when mounting the surface.

#### Lit

```typescript
import {html, render} from 'lit';
import '@a2ui/lit';
import {Catalog, MessageProcessor} from '@a2ui/web_core';
import {BASIC_FUNCTIONS, basicCatalog} from '@a2ui/web_core/catalogs/basic/v1';
import {statCardComponent} from './stat-card.js';

const analyticsCatalog = new Catalog(
  'https://example.com/catalogs/analytics/v1/catalog.json',
  '1.0',
  [...basicCatalog.components.values(), statCardComponent],
  BASIC_FUNCTIONS,
);

export const processor = new MessageProcessor([analyticsCatalog], action => {
  console.log('Action:', action);
});

processor.onSurfaceCreated(surface => {
  render(html`<a2ui-surface .surface=${surface}></a2ui-surface>`, document.body);
});
```

#### React

```tsx
import {useEffect, useMemo, useState} from 'react';
import {A2uiSurface, type ReactCatalogComponent} from '@a2ui/react';
import {Catalog, MessageProcessor, type SurfaceModel} from '@a2ui/web_core';
import {BASIC_FUNCTIONS, basicCatalog} from '@a2ui/web_core/catalogs/basic/v1';
import {statCardComponent} from './stat-card.js';

const analyticsCatalog = new Catalog<ReactCatalogComponent>(
  'https://example.com/catalogs/analytics/v1/catalog.json',
  '1.0',
  [...basicCatalog.components.values(), statCardComponent],
  BASIC_FUNCTIONS,
);

export function App() {
  const [surface, setSurface] = useState<SurfaceModel<ReactCatalogComponent>>();
  const processor = useMemo(
    () => new MessageProcessor([analyticsCatalog], action => console.log('Action:', action)),
    [],
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    const sub = processor.onSurfaceCreated(setSurface);
    return () => sub.unsubscribe();
  }, [processor]);

  return surface ? <A2uiSurface surface={surface} /> : null;
}
```

#### Angular

```typescript
import {ApplicationConfig, Component} from '@angular/core';
import {
  AngularCatalog,
  BASIC_COMPONENTS,
  BASIC_FUNCTIONS,
  SurfaceComponent,
  provideA2UI,
} from '@a2ui/angular';
import {statCardComponent} from './stat-card.js';

const analyticsCatalog = new AngularCatalog(
  'https://example.com/catalogs/analytics/v1/catalog.json',
  '1.0',
  [...BASIC_COMPONENTS, statCardComponent],
  BASIC_FUNCTIONS,
);

export const appConfig: ApplicationConfig = {
  providers: [
    provideA2UI({
      catalogs: [analyticsCatalog],
      actionHandler: action => console.log('Action:', action),
    }),
  ],
};

@Component({
  selector: 'app-root',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [SurfaceComponent],
  // SurfaceComponent from @a2ui/angular uses 'a2ui-v09-surface' in both v1.0 and v0.9.1.
  template: `<a2ui-v09-surface surfaceId="main" />`,
})
export class AppComponent {}
```

If your app targets v0.9.1, pass `'0.9'` as the catalog version and import from `'@a2ui/lit/v0_9'`, `'@a2ui/react/v0_9'`, `'@a2ui/web_core/v0_9'`, `'@a2ui/web_core/v0_9/basic_catalog'`, or `provideA2Ui({useUniversalComponents: true, ...})` from `'@a2ui/angular/v0_9'`. For agent transport setup, see [How to Integrate A2UI into a Client](/guides/client-integration/).

When your agent streams a `createSurface` and `updateComponents` message pair, the host renderer mounts `<a2ui-stat-card>` with the resolved properties:

#### v1.0

```json
[
  {
    "version": "1.0",
    "createSurface": {
      "surfaceId": "main",
      "catalogId": "https://example.com/catalogs/analytics/v1/catalog.json"
    }
  },
  {
    "version": "1.0",
    "updateComponents": {
      "surfaceId": "main",
      "components": [
        {"id": "root", "component": "StatCard", "label": "Monthly revenue", "value": "$12,400"}
      ]
    }
  }
]
```

#### v0.9.1

```json
[
  {
    "version": "v0.9",
    "createSurface": {
      "surfaceId": "main",
      "catalogId": "https://example.com/catalogs/analytics/v1/catalog.json"
    }
  },
  {
    "version": "v0.9",
    "updateComponents": {
      "surfaceId": "main",
      "components": [
        {"id": "root", "component": "StatCard", "label": "Monthly revenue", "value": "$12,400"}
      ]
    }
  }
]
```

## Resolved property types

`@a2ui/lit` re-exports `A2uiLitElement` from `@a2ui/web_core/universal`, so universal components and [`@a2ui/lit` custom components](https://github.com/a2ui-project/a2ui/blob/main/typescript/renderers/lit/README.md) access resolved schema properties on `this.controller.props` in the same way:

- **Actions** (`ActionSchema` / [`Action`](/specification/v1.0/schemas/#common_types.json/$defs/Action)): resolves to an async `() => Promise<void>` callback (`props.action?.()`) that dispatches an agent `event` or executes a catalog `functionCall` (see [Actions and Functions](/concepts/actions-and-functions/)).
- **Child components** (`ChildSchema` / [`ComponentId`](/specification/v1.0/schemas/#common_types.json/$defs/ComponentId) and `ChildListSchema` / [`ChildList`](/specification/v1.0/schemas/#common_types.json/$defs/ChildList)): resolves to a child reference or array of references. Pass each entry to `this.renderNode(ref)` inside `render()` to mount Basic Catalog, universal, or native React and Angular children.
- **Two-way data binding** (`DynamicStringSchema`, `DynamicNumberSchema`, `DynamicBooleanSchema`, `DynamicStringListSchema`, `DynamicValueSchema` / [`DynamicValue`](/specification/v1.0/schemas/#common_types.json/$defs/DynamicValue)): generates a `props.set<CapitalizedProp>(nextValue)` setter (such as `props.setValue(e.target.value)`) that writes to the bound JSON Pointer (`@path` in v1.0, `path` in v0.9.1) in the surface `DataModel` (see [Data Model and Data Binding](/concepts/data-binding/)).
- **Validation checks** (`z.object({...}).merge(CheckableSchema)` / [`Checkable`](/specification/v1.0/schemas/#common_types.json/$defs/Checkable)): evaluates `checks` rules reactively and populates `props.isValid` (`boolean`) and `props.validationErrors` (`string[]`). Bind `aria-invalid` and `aria-describedby` on the inner input control rather than `role="alert"` so initial validation checks do not trigger unsolicited screen-reader announcements on mount.

## Advanced topics

### Light DOM, Shadow DOM, and host CSS theming

Unlike a standard `LitElement`, `A2uiLitElement` renders into the Light DOM by default (`createRenderRoot()` returns `this`) so the host application's global stylesheet, design system, and utility classes (such as Tailwind CSS) apply directly inside your component. `A2uiLitElement.adoptLightDomStyles()` still applies `static override styles` on connection: it rewrites `:host` selectors to the custom element's tag name, prefixes descendant rules with that tag name to prevent style leaks, and adopts the scoped `CSSStyleSheet` once into the enclosing `Document` or `ShadowRoot`.

You can theme the component from the host application using CSS custom properties:

#### Lit

Set custom properties in the enclosing Lit component's `static override styles` (or on `:root` in a global stylesheet):

```typescript
static override styles = css`
  a2ui-stat-card {
    --border-color: #3b82f6;
  }
`;
```

#### React

Set custom properties in your application stylesheet (such as `App.css`):

```css
a2ui-stat-card {
  --border-color: #3b82f6;
}
```

#### Angular

Set custom properties in global `styles.css` (Angular's default emulated view encapsulation scopes component rules away from dynamically created elements):

```css
a2ui-stat-card {
  --border-color: #3b82f6;
}
```

If your component requires style encapsulation or native `<slot>` projection, opt into Shadow DOM by overriding `createRenderRoot()`:

```typescript
override createRenderRoot() {
  return this.attachShadow({mode: 'open'});
}
```

### Writing a universal component without Lit (`HTMLElement` + `GenericBinder`)

Lit simplifies templates, but the renderer contract has no Lit dependency. Any class extending `HTMLElement` and implementing `A2uiWebComponentElement` works across Lit, React, and Angular:

1. Extend `HTMLElement` and implement `A2uiWebComponentElement` with a `context` setter accepting `ComponentContext` from the host renderer.
2. Instantiate `new GenericBinder(context, schema)` when connected and subscribe to property updates to mutate the DOM.
3. Unsubscribe and call `binder.dispose()` in `disconnectedCallback()` and before rebinding to a new context.
4. Export a `WebComponentImplementation` with your API, `tagName`, and element constructor.

The example below implements a `StatBadgeElement` for a `StatBadgeApi` schema with `label`, `value`, and optional `children` properties, keying cached child DOM elements by `${childId}:${childPath}` so repeating template items preserve focus and internal state across data updates:

#### v1.0

```typescript
// stat-badge.ts
import {z} from 'zod';
import {ComponentContext, GenericBinder, type ResolveA2uiProps} from '@a2ui/web_core';
import {
  type A2uiWebComponentElement,
  type ResolvedChildList,
  type WebComponentImplementation,
  isWebComponentImplementation,
  registerUniversalElement,
} from '@a2ui/web_core/universal';
import {StatBadgeApi} from './stat-badge.api.js';

type StatBadgeProps = ResolveA2uiProps<z.infer<typeof StatBadgeApi.schema>>;

export class StatBadgeElement extends HTMLElement implements A2uiWebComponentElement {
  private binder?: GenericBinder<StatBadgeProps>;
  private subscription?: {unsubscribe(): void};
  private currentContext?: ComponentContext;
  private readonly labelEl = document.createElement('span');
  private readonly childElements = new Map<string, A2uiWebComponentElement>();

  get context() {
    return this.currentContext;
  }

  set context(context: ComponentContext | undefined) {
    this.currentContext = context;
    this.bind();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.bind();
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this.unbind();
  }

  private bind() {
    this.unbind();
    if (!this.currentContext || !this.isConnected) return;
    this.binder = new GenericBinder(this.currentContext, StatBadgeApi.schema);
    this.subscription = this.binder.subscribe(props => this.render(props));
    this.render(this.binder.snapshot);
  }

  private unbind() {
    this.subscription?.unsubscribe();
    this.binder?.dispose();
    this.subscription = undefined;
    this.binder = undefined;
  }

  private render(props: StatBadgeProps) {
    const label = typeof props.label === 'string' ? props.label : '';
    const value = typeof props.value === 'string' ? props.value : '';
    this.labelEl.textContent = `${label}: ${value}`;
    this.replaceChildren(this.labelEl, ...this.renderChildren(props.children ?? []));
  }

  private renderChildren(children: ResolvedChildList): A2uiWebComponentElement[] {
    const {surface, path} = this.currentContext!.dataContext;
    if (!surface) return [];
    const elements: A2uiWebComponentElement[] = [];
    for (const childRef of children) {
      const childId = typeof childRef === 'string' ? childRef : childRef.id;
      const childPath = typeof childRef === 'string' ? path : childRef.basePath;
      const childKey = `${childId}:${childPath}`;
      const childContext = new ComponentContext(surface, childId, childPath);
      const catalog = childContext.componentModel.catalog ?? surface.defaultCatalog;
      const impl = catalog?.components.get(childContext.componentModel.type);
      if (!impl?.tagName) continue;
      if (isWebComponentImplementation(impl)) registerUniversalElement(impl);
      let el = this.childElements.get(childKey);
      if (!el || el.localName !== impl.tagName) {
        el = document.createElement(impl.tagName) as A2uiWebComponentElement;
        this.childElements.set(childKey, el);
      }
      el.context = childContext;
      elements.push(el);
    }
    return elements;
  }
}

export const statBadgeComponent: WebComponentImplementation<typeof StatBadgeApi.schema> = {
  ...StatBadgeApi,
  tagName: 'a2ui-stat-badge',
  element: StatBadgeElement,
};
```

#### v0.9.1

```typescript
// stat-badge.ts
import {z} from 'zod';
import {ComponentContext, GenericBinder, type ResolveA2uiProps} from '@a2ui/web_core/v0_9';
import {
  type A2uiWebComponentElement,
  type ResolvedChildList,
  type WebComponentImplementation,
  isWebComponentImplementation,
  registerUniversalElement,
} from '@a2ui/web_core/v0_9/universal';
import {StatBadgeApi} from './stat-badge.api.js';

type StatBadgeProps = ResolveA2uiProps<z.infer<typeof StatBadgeApi.schema>>;

export class StatBadgeElement extends HTMLElement implements A2uiWebComponentElement {
  private binder?: GenericBinder<StatBadgeProps>;
  private subscription?: {unsubscribe(): void};
  private currentContext?: ComponentContext;
  private readonly labelEl = document.createElement('span');
  private readonly childElements = new Map<string, A2uiWebComponentElement>();

  get context() {
    return this.currentContext;
  }

  set context(context: ComponentContext | undefined) {
    this.currentContext = context;
    this.bind();
  }

  connectedCallback() {
    this.bind();
  }

  disconnectedCallback() {
    this.unbind();
  }

  private bind() {
    this.unbind();
    if (!this.currentContext || !this.isConnected) return;
    this.binder = new GenericBinder(this.currentContext, StatBadgeApi.schema);
    this.subscription = this.binder.subscribe(props => this.render(props));
    this.render(this.binder.snapshot);
  }

  private unbind() {
    this.subscription?.unsubscribe();
    this.binder?.dispose();
    this.subscription = undefined;
    this.binder = undefined;
  }

  private render(props: StatBadgeProps) {
    this.labelEl.textContent = `${props.label ?? ''}: ${props.value ?? ''}`;
    this.replaceChildren(this.labelEl, ...this.renderChildren(props.children ?? []));
  }

  private renderChildren(children: ResolvedChildList): A2uiWebComponentElement[] {
    const {surface, path} = this.currentContext!.dataContext;
    if (!surface) return [];
    const elements: A2uiWebComponentElement[] = [];
    for (const childRef of children) {
      const childId = typeof childRef === 'string' ? childRef : childRef.id;
      const childPath = typeof childRef === 'string' ? path : childRef.basePath;
      const childKey = `${childId}:${childPath}`;
      const childContext = new ComponentContext(surface, childId, childPath);
      const catalog = childContext.componentModel.catalog ?? surface.defaultCatalog;
      const impl = catalog?.components.get(childContext.componentModel.type);
      if (!impl?.tagName) continue;
      if (isWebComponentImplementation(impl)) registerUniversalElement(impl);
      let el = this.childElements.get(childKey);
      if (!el || el.localName !== impl.tagName) {
        el = document.createElement(impl.tagName) as A2uiWebComponentElement;
        this.childElements.set(childKey, el);
      }
      el.context = childContext;
      elements.push(el);
    }
    return elements;
  }
}

export const statBadgeComponent: WebComponentImplementation<typeof StatBadgeApi.schema> = {
  ...StatBadgeApi,
  tagName: 'a2ui-stat-badge',
  element: StatBadgeElement,
};
```

# How to Integrate A2UI into a Client

> Step-by-step guide to integrating A2UI client renderers into Flutter, React, Lit, Angular, SwiftUI, and Jetpack Compose apps.

Canonical URL: https://a2ui.org/guides/client-integration/

Integrate an A2UI [renderer](/concepts/glossary/#renderer) into a Flutter, React, Lit, Angular, SwiftUI, or Jetpack Compose application using the [Renderer SDKs](/concepts/sdks/#renderer-sdk) to display interactive UIs from an AI agent and send user actions back.

For the agent side, see [How to Integrate A2UI into an Agent](/guides/agent-integration/). If your agent and renderer live in the same binary or codebase, combine both guides, skip the transport step, and pass messages directly from agent output into the rendering pipeline (the Agent and Renderer SDKs share the same [Core SDK](/concepts/sdks/#core-sdk) data structures). To register custom widgets beyond the built-in Basic catalog, see [How to Define a Catalog](/guides/defining-a-catalog/) and [Authoring Universal Web Components](/guides/authoring-universal-components/).

---

## Step 1: Install dependencies

Install the Renderer SDK and Core SDK packages for your target UI framework:

#### Flutter

```bash
flutter pub add a2ui_flutter a2ui_core url_launcher
```

#### React

```bash
# Requires react and react-dom ^17.0.0 || ^18.0.0 || ^19.0.0
npm install @a2ui/react @a2ui/web_core @a2ui/markdown-it zod
```

#### Lit

```bash
npm install @a2ui/lit @a2ui/web_core @a2ui/markdown-it lit zod
```

#### Angular

```bash
# Requires @angular/core, @angular/common, and @angular/platform-browser ^21.2.5
npm install @a2ui/angular @a2ui/web_core @a2ui/markdown-it zod
```

#### SwiftUI

Add the Swift packages to `Package.swift` (iOS 17+ / macOS 14+):

```swift
dependencies: [
  .package(url: "https://github.com/a2ui-project/a2ui.git", branch: "main"),
  .package(url: "https://github.com/ajevans99/swift-json-schema", .upToNextMinor(from: "0.13.1")),
],
targets: [
  .target(
    name: "MyApp",
    dependencies: [
      .product(name: "A2UISwiftCore", package: "a2ui"),
      .product(name: "A2UISwiftUI", package: "a2ui"),
      .product(name: "BasicCatalogSwiftUI", package: "a2ui"),
      .product(name: "OrderedJSON", package: "swift-json-schema"),
    ]
  ),
]
```

#### Jetpack Compose

Add `google()` to your Gradle repositories and declare the `androidx.a2ui` dependencies in `build.gradle.kts`. `1.0.0-alpha02` currently targets A2UI `v0.9.1` on the wire while `v1.0` support is in progress:

```kotlin
dependencies {
    val a2uiVersion = "1.0.0-alpha02"
    implementation("androidx.a2ui:a2ui-model:$a2uiVersion")
    implementation("androidx.a2ui:a2ui-engine:$a2uiVersion")
    implementation("androidx.a2ui.compose:compose-runtime:$a2uiVersion")
    implementation("androidx.a2ui.compose:compose-ui:$a2uiVersion")
    implementation("androidx.compose.material3:material3-a2ui:$a2uiVersion")
}
```

---

## Step 2: Initialize MessageProcessor

Create a [`MessageProcessor`](/concepts/glossary/#messageprocessor) instance inside a session controller or service with the built-in [Basic catalog](/specification/v1.0-basic-catalog-implementation-guide/#basic_catalog.json) and an action callback that forwards user events to the transport method you will add in [Step 4](#step-4-connect-transport-and-handle-actions).

The scope of the rendering session determines which [surfaces](/concepts/glossary/#surface) the agent can modify. In a chat app, you can use one `MessageProcessor` per conversation to allow the agent to update or delete any surface in the conversation at any time by its `surfaceId`, or use one `MessageProcessor` per chat turn so the agent only modifies surfaces in the active turn and does not need unique surface IDs across turns. To register custom components or local functions alongside the Basic catalog, see [How to Define a Catalog](/guides/defining-a-catalog/).

#### Flutter

```dart
import 'dart:convert';

import 'package:a2ui_core/a2ui_core.dart';
import 'package:a2ui_flutter/a2ui_flutter.dart';
import 'package:a2ui_flutter/basic_catalog.dart';
import 'package:url_launcher/url_launcher.dart';

class AgentSession {
  AgentSession({required this.sendOverTransport}) {
    processor = MessageProcessor<ComponentImplementation>(
      catalogs: [
        basicCatalog(
          openUrl: (url) async {
            await launchUrl(url);
          },
        ),
        // Add custom domain catalogs here (see /guides/defining-a-catalog/).
      ],
      onAction: (action) {
        // Optional (default: null)
        sendToAgent(ActionMessage(version: '1.0', action: action).toJson());
      },
    );
  }

  final void Function(Map<String, Object?> message) sendOverTransport;

  late final MessageProcessor<ComponentImplementation> processor;
}
```

#### React

```ts
import {renderMarkdown} from '@a2ui/markdown-it';
import type {ReactCatalogComponent} from '@a2ui/react';
import {
  type ActionPayload,
  MessageProcessor,
  basicCatalog,
  injectBasicCatalogStyles,
  setMarkdownRenderer,
} from '@a2ui/web_core/v1_0';

injectBasicCatalogStyles();
setMarkdownRenderer(renderMarkdown);

export class AgentSession {
  readonly processor = new MessageProcessor<ReactCatalogComponent>(
    [
      basicCatalog,
      // Add custom domain catalogs here (see /guides/defining-a-catalog/).
    ],
    // Optional (default: undefined)
    (action: ActionPayload) => void this.sendToAgent({version: '1.0', action}),
  );
}
```

#### Lit

```ts
import type {LitComponentApi} from '@a2ui/lit';
import {renderMarkdown} from '@a2ui/markdown-it';
import {
  type ActionPayload,
  MessageProcessor,
  basicCatalog,
  injectBasicCatalogStyles,
  setMarkdownRenderer,
} from '@a2ui/web_core/v1_0';

injectBasicCatalogStyles();
setMarkdownRenderer(renderMarkdown);

export class AgentSession {
  readonly processor = new MessageProcessor<LitComponentApi>(
    [
      basicCatalog,
      // Add custom domain catalogs here (see /guides/defining-a-catalog/).
    ],
    // Optional (default: undefined)
    (action: ActionPayload) => void this.sendToAgent({version: '1.0', action}),
  );
}
```

#### Angular

```ts
import {ApplicationConfig, Injector, inject} from '@angular/core';
import {BasicCatalog, provideA2UI, provideMarkdownRenderer} from '@a2ui/angular';
import {renderMarkdown} from '@a2ui/markdown-it';
import {type ActionPayload, injectBasicCatalogStyles} from '@a2ui/web_core/v1_0';

import {AgentSessionService} from './agent-session.service';

injectBasicCatalogStyles();

export const appConfig: ApplicationConfig = {
  providers: [
    provideA2UI(() => {
      const injector = inject(Injector);
      return {
        catalogs: [
          new BasicCatalog(),
          // Add custom domain catalogs here (see /guides/defining-a-catalog/).
        ],
        // Optional (default: undefined)
        actionHandler: (action: ActionPayload) =>
          void injector.get(AgentSessionService).sendToAgent({version: '1.0', action}),
      };
    }),
    provideMarkdownRenderer(renderMarkdown),
  ],
};
```

#### SwiftUI

```swift
import A2UICore
import A2UISwiftUI
import BasicCatalogSwiftUI
import Combine
import Foundation

@MainActor
final class A2UISessionController: ObservableObject {
  let catalogs: [Catalog<ComponentImplementation>]
  let processor: MessageProcessor
  let sendOverTransport: @Sendable (Data) -> Void

  init(sendOverTransport: @escaping @Sendable (Data) -> Void) {
    self.sendOverTransport = sendOverTransport
    let basic = BasicCatalogImplementation.makeCatalog(version: .v10, locale: .current)
    // Add custom domain catalogs here (see /guides/defining-a-catalog/).
    self.catalogs = [basic]
    self.processor = MessageProcessor(
      catalogs: self.catalogs.map { $0 as any CatalogProtocol }
    )
    self.processor.outboundListener = { [weak self] message in
      // Optional (default: nil); receives .action, .callAgentFunction, .rendererFunctionResponse, and .error.
      Task { @MainActor [weak self] in
        try? self?.sendToAgent(message: message)
      }
    }
  }
}
```

#### Jetpack Compose

```kotlin
import android.app.Application
import androidx.a2ui.compose.runtime.A2uiMessageParser
import androidx.a2ui.compose.ui.A2uiMessageProcessor
import androidx.a2ui.compose.ui.catalog.A2uiBasicCatalogV1
import androidx.a2ui.model.catalog.functions.A2uiLocaleProvider
import androidx.a2ui.model.processor.A2uiSurfaceModel
import androidx.a2ui.model.processor.processInput
import androidx.compose.material3.a2ui.catalog.MaterialA2uiBasicCatalogV1Defaults
import androidx.compose.material3.a2ui.catalog.materialA2uiBasicCatalogV1
import androidx.lifecycle.AndroidViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineStart
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch

class AgentSessionViewModel(application: Application) : AndroidViewModel(application) {
    val basicCatalog = materialA2uiBasicCatalogV1(
        image = MaterialA2uiBasicCatalogV1Defaults.image { _, _, _, _, _ -> },
        video = MaterialA2uiBasicCatalogV1Defaults.video { _, _, _ -> },
        audioPlayer = MaterialA2uiBasicCatalogV1Defaults.audioPlayer { _, _, _, _ -> },
        functions = A2uiBasicCatalogV1.Functions(application, A2uiLocaleProvider.Default),
    )

    private val parser = A2uiMessageParser()
    val processor = A2uiMessageProcessor(
        catalogs = listOf(
            basicCatalog,
            // Add custom domain catalogs here (see /guides/defining-a-catalog/).
        ),
    )

    val a2uiSurfaces: StateFlow<List<A2uiSurfaceModel>> = processor.activeSurfaces

    init {
        viewModelScope.launch(Dispatchers.Default) {
            processor.collectMessages()
        }
        viewModelScope.launch(start = CoroutineStart.UNDISPATCHED) {
            processor.outboundEvents.collect { event ->
                handleOutboundEvent(event)
            }
        }
    }
}
```

---

## Step 3: Mount surface views

Create a container view that subscribes to the active [surfaces](/concepts/glossary/#surface) on `MessageProcessor` and renders an A2UI surface component for each one. Your container mounts new surfaces when `createSurface` arrives and unmounts them when `deleteSurface` arrives, while each mounted surface observes its own component tree and `DataModel` internally to update child components in place as `updateComponents` and `updateDataModel` messages arrive.

#### Flutter

```dart
import 'package:a2ui_core/a2ui_core.dart';
import 'package:a2ui_flutter/a2ui_flutter.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

class AgentSurfacesView extends StatefulWidget {
  const AgentSurfacesView({super.key, required this.processor});

  final MessageProcessor<ComponentImplementation> processor;

  @override
  State<AgentSurfacesView> createState() => _AgentSurfacesViewState();
}

class _AgentSurfacesViewState extends State<AgentSurfacesView> {
  late final Subscription _createdSub;
  late final Subscription _deletedSub;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _createdSub = widget.processor.model.onSurfaceCreated.subscribe((_) {
      setState(() {});
    });
    _deletedSub = widget.processor.model.onSurfaceDeleted.subscribe((_) {
      setState(() {});
    });
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _createdSub.unsubscribe();
    _deletedSub.unsubscribe();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final surfaces = widget.processor.model.allSurfaces;
    return ListView(
      children: [
        for (final surface in surfaces)
          KeyedSubtree(
            key: ValueKey(surface.id),
            child: A2uiSurface(surface: surface),
          ),
      ],
    );
  }
}
```

#### React

```tsx
import {A2uiSurface, type ReactCatalogComponent} from '@a2ui/react';
import type {MessageProcessor, SurfaceModel} from '@a2ui/web_core/v1_0';
import {useEffect, useState} from 'react';

export function AgentSurfaces({processor}: {processor: MessageProcessor<ReactCatalogComponent>}) {
  const [surfaces, setSurfaces] = useState<SurfaceModel<ReactCatalogComponent>[]>(() =>
    Array.from(processor.getSurfaces().values()),
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    const sync = () => setSurfaces(Array.from(processor.getSurfaces().values()));
    const createdSub = processor.onSurfaceCreated(sync);
    const deletedSub = processor.onSurfaceDeleted(sync);
    sync();
    return () => {
      createdSub.unsubscribe();
      deletedSub.unsubscribe();
    };
  }, [processor]);

  return (
    <div className="a2ui-surfaces">
      {surfaces.map(surface => (
        <A2uiSurface key={surface.id} surface={surface} />
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}
```

#### Lit

```ts
import '@a2ui/lit';
import type {LitComponentApi} from '@a2ui/lit';
import type {MessageProcessor, Subscription} from '@a2ui/web_core/v1_0';
import {LitElement, type PropertyValues, html} from 'lit';
import {customElement, property} from 'lit/decorators.js';
import {repeat} from 'lit/directives/repeat.js';

@customElement('agent-surfaces')
export class AgentSurfacesElement extends LitElement {
  @property({attribute: false})
  accessor processor!: MessageProcessor<LitComponentApi>;

  private subscriptions: Subscription[] = [];

  private subscribeToProcessor() {
    for (const sub of this.subscriptions) {
      sub.unsubscribe();
    }
    this.subscriptions = [];
    if (this.processor) {
      this.subscriptions.push(
        this.processor.onSurfaceCreated(() => this.requestUpdate()),
        this.processor.onSurfaceDeleted(() => this.requestUpdate()),
      );
    }
  }

  protected override willUpdate(changedProperties: PropertyValues<this>) {
    if (changedProperties.has('processor')) {
      this.subscribeToProcessor();
    }
  }

  override connectedCallback() {
    super.connectedCallback();
    if (this.processor && this.subscriptions.length === 0) {
      this.subscribeToProcessor();
    }
  }

  override disconnectedCallback() {
    for (const sub of this.subscriptions) {
      sub.unsubscribe();
    }
    this.subscriptions = [];
    super.disconnectedCallback();
  }

  override render() {
    const surfaces = this.processor ? Array.from(this.processor.getSurfaces().values()) : [];
    return html`
      ${repeat(
        surfaces,
        surface => surface.id,
        surface => html`<a2ui-surface .surface=${surface}></a2ui-surface>`,
      )}
    `;
  }
}
```

#### Angular

```ts
import {ChangeDetectionStrategy, Component, DestroyRef, inject, signal} from '@angular/core';
import {A2uiRendererService, SurfaceComponent} from '@a2ui/angular';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-agent-surfaces',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [SurfaceComponent],
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
  template: `
    @for (surfaceId of surfaceIds(); track surfaceId) {
      <a2ui-v09-surface [surfaceId]="surfaceId" />
    }
  `,
})
export class AgentSurfacesComponent {
  private readonly renderer = inject(A2uiRendererService);
  private readonly destroyRef = inject(DestroyRef);

  readonly surfaceIds = signal<string[]>(this.readSurfaceIds());

  constructor() {
    const sync = () => this.surfaceIds.set(this.readSurfaceIds());
    const createdSub = this.renderer.surfaceGroup.onSurfaceCreated.subscribe(sync);
    const deletedSub = this.renderer.surfaceGroup.onSurfaceDeleted.subscribe(sync);
    this.destroyRef.onDestroy(() => {
      createdSub.unsubscribe();
      deletedSub.unsubscribe();
    });
  }

  private readSurfaceIds(): string[] {
    return Array.from(this.renderer.surfaceGroup.surfacesMap.keys());
  }
}
```

> **Note**
  In `@a2ui/angular`, `SurfaceComponent` currently uses the `<a2ui-v09-surface>` selector for A2UI
  `v1.0` surfaces (tracked in [#4009](https://github.com/a2ui-project/a2ui/issues/4009)). The
  unversioned `<a2ui-surface>` selector in `@a2ui/angular/v0_8` belongs only to the legacy `v0.8`
  renderer.

#### SwiftUI

```swift
import A2UICore
import A2UISwiftUI
import SwiftUI

struct AgentSurfacesView: View {
  @ObservedObject var surfaceGroup: SurfaceGroupModel
  let catalogs: [Catalog<ComponentImplementation>]

  var body: some View {
    ScrollView {
      VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 16) {
        ForEach(surfaceGroup.surfacesMap.keys.sorted(), id: \.self) { surfaceID in
          if let viewModel = surfaceGroup.surfacesMap[surfaceID] {
            Surface(viewModel: viewModel, catalogs: catalogs)
          }
        }
      }
      .padding()
    }
  }
}
```

#### Jetpack Compose

```kotlin
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Arrangement
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Column
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.fillMaxWidth
import androidx.compose.material3.a2ui.A2uiSurface
import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
import androidx.compose.runtime.getValue

    Column(
        modifier = modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(16.dp),
    ) {
        surfaces.forEach { surface ->
            key(surface.id) {
```

## Step 4: Connect transport and handle actions

Add inbound and outbound transport methods to your session controller or service to decode incoming JSON payloads into `MessageProcessor` and send resolved [`action`](/concepts/messages/#action) messages back to your agent. A2UI is transport-agnostic, so these methods can exchange messages over HTTP responses, Server-Sent Events (SSE), WebSockets, [A2A](/specification/v1.0-a2ui-extension-specification/), or [MCP](/guides/mcp-overview/).

#### Flutter

```dart
void onTransportChunk(String rawJson) {
  final Object? decoded = jsonDecode(rawJson);
  processor.processMessages(decoded);
}

void sendToAgent(Map<String, Object?> wireMessage) {
  sendOverTransport(wireMessage);
}
```

#### React

```ts
async onTransportChunk(rawJson: string): Promise<void> {
  const payload = JSON.parse(rawJson);
  await this.processor.processMessagesAsync(payload);
}

async sendToAgent(wireMessage: unknown): Promise<void> {
  const response = await fetch('/api/agent', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
    body: JSON.stringify({message: wireMessage}),
  });
  if (!response.ok) return;
  const body = (await response.text()).trim();
  if (body) {
    await this.onTransportChunk(body);
  }
}
```

#### Lit

```ts
async onTransportChunk(rawJson: string): Promise<void> {
  const payload = JSON.parse(rawJson);
  await this.processor.processMessagesAsync(payload);
}

async sendToAgent(wireMessage: unknown): Promise<void> {
  const response = await fetch('/api/agent', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
    body: JSON.stringify({message: wireMessage}),
  });
  if (!response.ok) return;
  const body = (await response.text()).trim();
  if (body) {
    await this.onTransportChunk(body);
  }
}
```

#### Angular

```ts
import {Injectable, inject} from '@angular/core';
import {A2uiRendererService} from '@a2ui/angular';

@Injectable({providedIn: 'root'})
export class AgentSessionService {
  private readonly renderer = inject(A2uiRendererService);

  async onTransportChunk(rawJson: string): Promise<void> {
    const payload = JSON.parse(rawJson);
    await this.renderer.processMessagesAsync(payload);
  }

  async sendToAgent(wireMessage: unknown): Promise<void> {
    const response = await fetch('/api/agent', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
      body: JSON.stringify({message: wireMessage}),
    });
    if (!response.ok) return;
    const body = (await response.text()).trim();
    if (body) {
      await this.onTransportChunk(body);
    }
  }
}
```

#### SwiftUI

```swift
import A2UICore
import Foundation
import OrderedJSON

extension A2UISessionController {
  func onTransportChunk(_ rawData: Data) throws {
    let payload = try JSONValue.parse(rawData)
    processor.process(payload: payload)
  }

  func sendToAgent(message: RendererToAgentMessage) throws {
    let messageData = try JSONEncoder().encode(message)
    let envelope: JSONValue = [
      "message": try JSONValue.parse(messageData),
    ]
    sendOverTransport(try JSONEncoder().encode(envelope))
  }
}
```

#### Jetpack Compose

Because `1.0.0-alpha02` targets A2UI `v0.9.1`, `A2uiMessageParser` expects one `"version": "v0.9"` (or `"v0.9.1"`) JSON message object per call rather than a JSON array, with `https://a2ui.org/specification/v0_9/catalogs/basic/catalog.json` and `{"path": "..."}` data bindings, and outbound envelopes set `"version"` to `"v0.9"`:

```kotlin
import androidx.a2ui.model.protocol.A2uiClientErrorMessage
import androidx.a2ui.model.protocol.A2uiClientEventMessage
import androidx.a2ui.model.protocol.A2uiClientToServerMessage
import java.time.Instant

// Pass one JSON message object per call, not a JSON array.
fun onTransportMessage(rawJsonObject: String) {
    processor.processInput(parser, rawJsonObject)
}

private fun handleOutboundEvent(event: A2uiClientToServerMessage) {
    when (event) {
        is A2uiClientEventMessage -> {
            val wireMessage = mapOf(
                "version" to "v0.9",
                "action" to mapOf(
                    "name" to event.type,
                    "surfaceId" to event.surfaceId,
                    "sourceComponentId" to event.componentId,
                    "timestamp" to Instant.ofEpochMilli(event.timestamp).toString(),
                    "context" to event.context,
                ),
            )
            sendOverTransport(wireMessage)
        }
        is A2uiClientErrorMessage -> {
            val wireError = mapOf(
                "version" to "v0.9",
                "error" to mapOf(
                    "code" to event.code,
                    "surfaceId" to event.surfaceId,
                    "message" to event.message,
                ) + event.context,
            )
            sendOverTransport(wireError)
        }
    }
}

private fun sendOverTransport(message: Map<String, Any?>) {
    // POST mapOf("message" to message) to your agent endpoint and pass each
    // incoming JSON message object back to onTransportMessage(...).
}
```

<details>
<summary>Wire format: agent-to-renderer messages</summary>

Agents send [`createSurface`](/concepts/messages/#createsurface) followed by incremental [`updateComponents`](/concepts/messages/#updatecomponents) and [`updateDataModel`](/concepts/messages/#updatedatamodel) messages, and remove finished surfaces with [`deleteSurface`](/concepts/messages/#deletesurface):

<SchemaChips
  items={[
    {
      version: 'v1.0',
      label: 'agent_to_renderer.json',
      href: '/specification/v1.0/schemas/#agent_to_renderer.json',
      title: 'v1.0 Agent-to-Renderer Message Schema',
    },
    {
      version: 'v0.9.1',
      label: 'server_to_client.json',
      href: '/specification/v0.9.1/schemas/#server_to_client.json',
      title: 'v0.9.1 Server-to-Client Message Schema',
    },
  ]}
/>

## Step 5: Wire everything at the app entry point

Instantiate your session controller or service at the application entry point and pass its `MessageProcessor` to the surface container view from [Step 3](#step-3-mount-surface-views). Sharing this session connects user prompts and bidirectional agent messages to the rendered surfaces:

#### Flutter

```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import 'agent_session.dart';
import 'agent_surfaces_view.dart';

void main() {
  late final AgentSession session;
  session = AgentSession(
    sendOverTransport: (message) {
      // POST {'message': message} to your agent endpoint and pass each incoming
      // JSON payload back to session.onTransportChunk(chunk).
    },
  );

  runApp(
    MaterialApp(
      home: Scaffold(
        body: AgentSurfacesView(processor: session.processor),
        floatingActionButton: FloatingActionButton(
          onPressed: () {
            // Start an agent turn and pass each incoming JSON payload to
            // session.onTransportChunk(chunk).
          },
          child: const Icon(Icons.send),
        ),
      ),
    ),
  );
}
```

#### React

```tsx
import {useState} from 'react';

import {AgentSurfaces} from './AgentSurfaces';
import {AgentSession} from './agent-session';

export function App() {
  const [session] = useState(() => new AgentSession());

  async function startPrompt(prompt: string) {
    const response = await fetch('/api/agent', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
      body: JSON.stringify({prompt}),
    });
    if (!response.ok) return;
    const body = (await response.text()).trim();
    if (body) {
      await session.onTransportChunk(body);
    }
  }

  return (
    <main>
      <button type="button" onClick={() => void startPrompt('Show my order summary')}>
        Ask Agent
      </button>
      <AgentSurfaces processor={session.processor} />
    </main>
  );
}
```

#### Lit

```ts

      headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},

    if (!response.ok) return;

    if (body) {
      await this.session.onTransportChunk(body);
    }
  }

  override render() {
    return html`
      <button type="button" @click=${() => void this.startPrompt('Show my order summary')}>
        Ask Agent

    `;
  }
}
```

#### Angular


## Additional steps

### Customize Basic Catalog theme tokens on Web

Override the `--a2ui-*` CSS custom properties on `:root` or a container element to match your application's theme, or apply the `.a2ui-dark` and `.a2ui-light` classes to lock a color scheme. Calling `injectBasicCatalogStyles()` in [Step 2](#step-2-initialize-messageprocessor) adopts the default stylesheet into `document.adoptedStyleSheets` (and no-ops during server-side rendering):

```css
:root {
  --a2ui-color-primary: #0f766e;
  --a2ui-color-on-primary: #ffffff;
  --a2ui-color-background: #ffffff;
  --a2ui-color-surface: #f8fafc;
  --a2ui-color-on-background: #0f172a;
  --a2ui-font-family-title: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif;
  font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif;
}
```

In React, `setMarkdownRenderer(renderMarkdown)` from [Step 2](#step-2-initialize-messageprocessor) configures the built-in Basic catalog `Text` elements; if your custom React catalog components call `useMarkdownRenderer()`, also wrap your tree in `<MarkdownContext.Provider value={renderMarkdown}>` from `@a2ui/react`.

### Advertise renderer capabilities

Call `getRendererCapabilities()` on `MessageProcessor` and attach the result to your outbound transport [metadata](/concepts/messages/#metadata) under `a2uiRendererCapabilities` so the agent knows which catalogs and protocol versions your client supports. If your team owns both the agent and the client app with a fixed catalog set, you can skip runtime negotiation and target those catalogs directly on the agent. Keep `includeInlineCatalogs` at its default `false` in production when the agent already holds matching `catalogId` schemas; set it to `true` only during prototyping when the agent accepts client-supplied inline schemas.

#### Flutter

```dart
Map<String, Object?> buildCapabilitiesMetadata() {
  final capabilities = processor
      .getRendererCapabilities(
        const CapabilitiesOptions(
          versions: [A2uiProtocolVersion.v1_0],
          includeInlineCatalogs: false, // Optional (default: false)
        ),
      )
      .toJson();

  return {
    'a2uiRendererCapabilities': capabilities,
  };
}
```

#### React

```ts
buildCapabilitiesMetadata() {
  return {
    a2uiRendererCapabilities: this.processor.getRendererCapabilities({
      versions: ['1.0'],
      includeInlineCatalogs: false, // Optional (default: false)
    }),
  };
}
```

#### Lit

```ts
buildCapabilitiesMetadata() {
  return {
    a2uiRendererCapabilities: this.processor.getRendererCapabilities({
      versions: ['1.0'],
      includeInlineCatalogs: false, // Optional (default: false)
    }),
  };
}
```

#### Angular

```ts
buildCapabilitiesMetadata() {
  return {
    a2uiRendererCapabilities: this.renderer.processor.getRendererCapabilities({
      versions: ['1.0'],
      includeInlineCatalogs: false, // Optional (default: false)
    }),
  };
}
```

#### SwiftUI

```swift
import A2UICore
import OrderedJSON

extension A2UISessionController {
  func buildCapabilitiesMetadata() throws -> JSONValue {
    let capabilities = try processor.getRendererCapabilities(
      options: MessageProcessor.CapabilitiesOptions(
        versions: [.v10],
        includeInlineCatalogs: false // Optional (default: false)
      )
    )
    return [
      "a2uiRendererCapabilities": capabilities,
    ]
  }
}
```

#### Jetpack Compose

Because `1.0.0-alpha02` targets A2UI `v0.9.1`, capabilities are advertised under `a2uiClientCapabilities` (keyed by `"v0.9"`):

```kotlin
import androidx.a2ui.model.protocol.A2uiClientCapabilities

val capabilities = A2uiClientCapabilities(
    supportedCatalogIds = listOf(basicCatalog.id),
    inlineCatalogs = emptyList(), // Optional (default: emptyList())
)

fun buildCapabilitiesMetadata(): Map<String, Map<String, Any?>> {
    // Returns mapOf("a2uiClientCapabilities" to mapOf("v0.9" to mapOf("supportedCatalogIds" to listOf(...))))
    return capabilities.toPayloadMap()
}
```

<details>
<summary>Wire format: renderer capabilities metadata</summary>

`buildCapabilitiesMetadata()` produces the transport metadata envelope below (`"1.0"` in `v1.0`, `"v0.9"` in `v0.9.1`):

<SchemaChips
  items={[
    {
      version: 'v1.0',
      label: 'renderer_capabilities.json',
      href: '/specification/v1.0/schemas/#renderer_capabilities.json',
      title: 'v1.0 Renderer Capabilities Schema',
    },
    {
      version: 'v0.9.1',
      label: 'client_capabilities.json',
      href: '/specification/v0.9.1/schemas/#client_capabilities.json',
      title: 'v0.9.1 Client Capabilities Schema',
    },
  ]}
/>

#### v1.0

```json
{
  "metadata": {
    "a2uiRendererCapabilities": {
      "1.0": {
        "supportedCatalogIds": ["https://a2ui.org/specification/v1_0/catalogs/basic/catalog.json"]
      }
    }
  }
}
```

#### v0.9.1

```json
{
  "metadata": {
    "a2uiClientCapabilities": {
      "v0.9": {
        "supportedCatalogIds": ["https://a2ui.org/specification/v0_9/catalogs/basic/catalog.json"]
      }
    }
  }
}
```

</details>

### Synchronize client data models and forward RPCs

Call `getRendererDataModel()` on `MessageProcessor` and attach the returned snapshot under `a2uiRendererDataModel` in your outbound transport metadata alongside `action` messages and user prompts. `MessageProcessor` returns data models for active surfaces created with `"sendDataModel": true`, such as multi-field forms where local input edits update the client `DataModel` without firing separate action events.

If your catalogs use v1.0 remote agent functions ([`callAgentFunction`](/concepts/messages/#callagentfunction-v10-only)) or agent-initiated client calls ([`callRendererFunction`](/concepts/messages/#callrendererfunction-v10-only)), pass `outboundListener` to `MessageProcessor` (`processorOptions.outboundListener` in Angular) to forward those envelopes through `sendToAgent`. To report malformed incoming payloads back to the agent as structured [`error`](/specification/v1.0/schemas/#renderer_to_agent.json/properties/error) messages instead of throwing exceptions, set `reportErrorsOnly: true` (paired with `errorHandler` on Web, or `outboundListener` on Flutter; SwiftUI and Jetpack Compose already emit validation errors on `outboundListener` and `outboundEvents`).

#### Flutter

```dart
Map<String, Object?> buildDataModelMetadata() {
  final dataModel = processor.getRendererDataModel();
  return {
    if (dataModel != null) 'a2uiRendererDataModel': dataModel,
  };
}
```

#### React

```ts
buildDataModelMetadata(): Record<string, unknown> {
  const dataModel = this.processor.getRendererDataModel();
  return dataModel !== undefined ? {a2uiRendererDataModel: dataModel} : {};
}
```

#### Lit

```ts
buildDataModelMetadata(): Record<string, unknown> {
  const dataModel = this.processor.getRendererDataModel();
  return dataModel !== undefined ? {a2uiRendererDataModel: dataModel} : {};
}
```

#### Angular

```ts
buildDataModelMetadata(): Record<string, unknown> {
  const dataModel = this.renderer.processor.getRendererDataModel();
  return dataModel !== undefined ? {a2uiRendererDataModel: dataModel} : {};
}
```

#### SwiftUI

```swift
import A2UICore
import OrderedJSON

extension A2UISessionController {
  func buildDataModelMetadata() throws -> JSONValue {
    if let dataModel = try processor.getRendererDataModel() {
      return [
        "a2uiRendererDataModel": dataModel,
      ]
    }
    return [:]
  }
}
```

#### Jetpack Compose

Because `1.0.0-alpha02` targets A2UI `v0.9.1`, `A2uiClientEventMessage.clientDataModel` is populated automatically for `sendDataModel = true` surfaces and attached under `a2uiClientDataModel`:

```kotlin
val metadata = buildMap<String, Any?> {
    event.clientDataModel?.let {
        put(
            "a2uiClientDataModel",
            mapOf("version" to "v0.9", "surfaces" to it.surfaces),
        )
    }
}
```

<details>
<summary>Wire format: outbound action with data-model metadata</summary>

When the user triggers an action on a `"sendDataModel": true` surface, attaching `buildDataModelMetadata()` alongside `message` produces the transport envelope below:

<SchemaChips
  items={[

/>

# How to Define a Catalog

> Create a minimal catalog.json file, load it on your agent, register matching UI widgets on your client app, and explore advanced catalog features.

Canonical URL: https://a2ui.org/guides/defining-a-catalog/

Define a custom A2UI catalog by writing a `catalog.json` schema file, loading it on your agent, and registering matching UI widgets on your client app under the same `catalogId`.

## When you need a catalog.json file

If your agent and client share the same language and repository, you can define component schemas directly in code, as shown in [Catalogs](/concepts/catalogs/#registering-a-catalog-in-a-renderer). Write a standalone `catalog.json` file when your backend agent and client app use different languages (for example, a Python agent serving a Flutter, React, SwiftUI, or Jetpack Compose app) or when you publish a reusable catalog for other teams.

In A2UI v1.0, your catalog works alongside the built-in [basic catalog](/specification/v1.0-basic-catalog-implementation-guide/#basic_catalog.json), so you keep standard layout widgets (`Column`, `Row`, `Text`, `Button`) and define only the custom widgets unique to your app. See [Catalogs](/concepts/catalogs/) for how catalog negotiation works at runtime.

## Step 1: Create a minimal catalog.json

Create a file named `status_catalog.json` that defines a single `StatusBadge` component with two properties: a bindable `label` string and a `status` tone.

#### v1.0

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$id": "https://example.com/catalogs/status/v1/catalog.json",
  "catalogId": "https://example.com/catalogs/status/v1/catalog.json",
  "protocolVersion": "1.0",
  "title": "Status Catalog",
  "components": {
    "StatusBadge": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "Displays a short status pill.",
      "properties": {
        "component": {"const": "StatusBadge"},
        "label": {"$ref": "common_types.json#/$defs/DynamicString"},
        "status": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": ["info", "success", "warning"]
        }
      },
      "required": ["component", "label", "status"]
    }
  },
  "$defs": {
    "anyComponent": {
      "oneOf": [{"$ref": "#/components/StatusBadge"}],
      "discriminator": {"propertyName": "component"}
    },
    "anyFunction": {"not": {}}
  }
}
```

#### v0.9.1

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$id": "https://example.com/catalogs/status/v0_9/catalog.json",
  "catalogId": "https://example.com/catalogs/status/v0_9/catalog.json",
  "title": "Status Catalog",
  "components": {
    "StatusBadge": {
      "type": "object",
      "allOf": [
        {
          "$ref": "https://a2ui.org/specification/v0_9/common_types.json#/$defs/ComponentCommon"
        },
        {
          "type": "object",
          "description": "Displays a short status pill.",
          "properties": {
            "component": {"const": "StatusBadge"},
            "label": {
              "$ref": "https://a2ui.org/specification/v0_9/common_types.json#/$defs/DynamicString"
            },
            "status": {
              "type": "string",
              "enum": ["info", "success", "warning"]
            }
          },
          "required": ["component", "label", "status"]
        }
      ],
      "unevaluatedProperties": false
    }
  },
  "$defs": {
    "anyComponent": {
      "oneOf": [{"$ref": "#/components/StatusBadge"}],
      "discriminator": {"propertyName": "component"}
    },
    "anyFunction": {"not": {}}
  }
}
```

| Field             | Purpose                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| ----------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `catalogId`       | Unique URI shared by the agent and client renderer. Version the URI path (`v1/`, `v2/`) when making breaking changes.                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `protocolVersion` | Wire version (`"1.0"`, without a leading `v`) validated against [`catalog_definition.json`](/specification/v1.0/schemas/#catalog_definition.json). Omitted in v0.9.1 standalone files.                                                                                                                                           |
| `components`      | Map of component schemas. Referencing `DynamicString` lets `label` accept either literal text or a data-model binding (`{"@path": "/statusText"}` in v1.0; `{"path": "/statusText"}` in v0.9.1). In v0.9.1, components also compose [`ComponentCommon`](/specification/v0.9.1/schemas/#common_types.json/$defs/ComponentCommon). |
| `$defs`           | Declares `anyComponent` (union of all components) and `anyFunction` (`{"not": {}}` when the catalog defines no custom functions).                                                                                                                                                                                                     |

## Step 2: Load the catalog on your agent

Load `status_catalog.json` with `Catalog.fromJson` (`Catalog.from_json` in Python) and pass it to `A2uiGenerator` alongside the basic catalog. `A2uiGenerator` automatically includes your component schema in the LLM prompt and validates generated messages against it.

#### TypeScript

```typescript
import {readFileSync} from 'node:fs';

import {A2uiGenerator, CatalogConfig, ExpressFormatFactory} from '@a2ui/agent';
import {Catalog} from '@a2ui/web_core';
import {basicCatalog} from '@a2ui/web_core/v1_0';

const statusCatalog = Catalog.fromJson(JSON.parse(readFileSync('./status_catalog.json', 'utf8')));

export const generator = new A2uiGenerator(
  [new CatalogConfig(basicCatalog), new CatalogConfig(statusCatalog)],
  undefined,
  new ExpressFormatFactory(),
);
```

#### Python

```python
import json
from pathlib import Path

from a2ui.core import Catalog
from a2ui.core.basic_catalog import BasicCatalog
from a2ui.inference_formats import ExpressFormatFactory
from a2ui.processor import A2uiGenerator, CatalogConfig

status_catalog = Catalog.from_json(
    json.loads(Path("./status_catalog.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
)

generator = A2uiGenerator(
    catalogs=[
        CatalogConfig(catalog=BasicCatalog("1.0")),
        CatalogConfig(catalog=status_catalog),
    ],
    inference_format_factory=ExpressFormatFactory(),
)
```

#### Dart

```dart
import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:io';

import 'package:a2ui_agent/a2ui_agent.dart';
import 'package:a2ui_core/a2ui_core.dart';

final CatalogApi statusCatalog = Catalog.fromJson(
  jsonDecode(File('./status_catalog.json').readAsStringSync())
      as Map<String, Object?>,
);

final generator = A2uiGenerator(
  catalogs: [
    CatalogConfig(BasicCatalog.v1_0()),
    CatalogConfig(statusCatalog),
  ],
  inferenceFormatFactory: const ExpressFormatFactory(),
);
```

Swift (`A2UISwiftCore` and `A2UISwiftUI`) and Kotlin (`androidx.a2ui` and `androidx.a2ui.compose`) are client-side renderer SDKs and do not include a server-side agent generator; see [How to Integrate A2UI into an Agent](/guides/agent-integration/) for full backend setup.

## Step 3: Register the widget on your client

Implement `StatusBadge` in your UI framework, wrap it in a `Catalog` with the same `catalogId` (`https://example.com/catalogs/status/v1/catalog.json`), and register it alongside the basic catalog in `MessageProcessor` (or `provideA2UI` in Angular). Once this minimal widget works end to end, see [Child slots and layout constraints](#child-slots-and-layout-constraints) for how nested child slots and interactive actions map to widget code.

#### Flutter

```dart
import 'package:a2ui_core/a2ui_core.dart';
import 'package:a2ui_flutter/a2ui_flutter.dart';
import 'package:a2ui_flutter/basic_catalog.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:json_schema_builder/json_schema_builder.dart';

final statusBadge = ComponentImplementation(
  name: 'StatusBadge',
  schema: Schema.object(
    properties: {
      'component': Schema.string(enumValues: ['StatusBadge']),
      'label': CommonSchemasV1.dynamicString,
      'status': Schema.string(enumValues: ['info', 'success', 'warning']),
    },
    required: ['component', 'label', 'status'],
  ),
  builder: (context, node, props, buildChild) {
    final String label = props.string('label') ?? '';
    final String status = props.string('status') ?? 'info';
    return Chip(label: Text('$status: $label'));
  },
);

final statusCatalog = Catalog<ComponentImplementation, FunctionImplementation>(
  id: 'https://example.com/catalogs/status/v1/catalog.json',
  protocolVersion: A2uiProtocolVersion.v1_0,
  components: [statusBadge],
);

final processor = MessageProcessor(catalogs: [basicCatalog(), statusCatalog]);
```

#### React

```tsx
import {z} from 'zod';

import {createComponentImplementation, type ReactCatalogComponent} from '@a2ui/react';
import {Catalog, DynamicStringSchema, MessageProcessor, basicCatalog} from '@a2ui/web_core/v1_0';

const StatusBadge = createComponentImplementation(
  {
    name: 'StatusBadge',
    schema: z.object({
      label: DynamicStringSchema,
      status: z.enum(['info', 'success', 'warning']),
    }),
  },
  ({props}) => <span className={`badge badge-${props.status}`}>{String(props.label ?? '')}</span>,
);

export const statusCatalog = new Catalog(
  'https://example.com/catalogs/status/v1/catalog.json',
  '1.0',
  [StatusBadge],
);

export const processor = new MessageProcessor<ReactCatalogComponent>([basicCatalog, statusCatalog]);
```

#### Lit

```typescript
import {html} from 'lit';
import {customElement} from 'lit/decorators.js';
import {z} from 'zod';

import {A2uiLitElement, type LitComponentApi} from '@a2ui/lit';
import {Catalog, DynamicStringSchema, MessageProcessor, basicCatalog} from '@a2ui/web_core/v1_0';

const StatusBadgeApi = {
  name: 'StatusBadge',
  schema: z.object({
    label: DynamicStringSchema,
    status: z.enum(['info', 'success', 'warning']),
  }),
};

@customElement('app-status-badge')
export class StatusBadgeElement extends A2uiLitElement<typeof StatusBadgeApi> {
  static readonly tagName = 'app-status-badge';
  protected override readonly api = StatusBadgeApi;

  override render() {
    const {label, status} = this.controller.props;
    return html`<span class="badge badge-${status}">${label ?? ''}</span>`;
  }
}

export const statusCatalog = new Catalog(
  'https://example.com/catalogs/status/v1/catalog.json',
  '1.0',
  [
    {
      ...StatusBadgeApi,
      tagName: StatusBadgeElement.tagName,
      element: StatusBadgeElement,
    } satisfies LitComponentApi,
  ],
);

export const processor = new MessageProcessor<LitComponentApi>([basicCatalog, statusCatalog]);
```

#### Angular

```typescript
import {ChangeDetectionStrategy, Component, computed} from '@angular/core';
import {bootstrapApplication} from '@angular/platform-browser';
import {z} from 'zod';

import {
  AngularCatalog,
  BasicCatalog,
  CatalogComponent,
  createComponentImplementation,
  provideA2UI,
} from '@a2ui/angular';
import {type ComponentApi} from '@a2ui/web_core';
import {DynamicStringSchema} from '@a2ui/web_core/v1_0';

const StatusBadgeApi = {
  name: 'StatusBadge',
  schema: z.object({
    label: DynamicStringSchema,
    status: z.enum(['info', 'success', 'warning']),
  }),
} satisfies ComponentApi;

@Component({
  selector: 'app-status-badge',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
  template: `<span [class]="'badge badge-' + status()">{{ label() }}</span>`,
})
export class StatusBadgeComponent extends CatalogComponent<typeof StatusBadgeApi> {
  readonly label = computed(() => {
    const value = this.props().label?.value();
    return typeof value === 'string' ? value : '';
  });
  readonly status = computed(() => this.props().status?.value() ?? 'info');
}

export const statusCatalog = new AngularCatalog(
  'https://example.com/catalogs/status/v1/catalog.json',
  '1.0',
  [createComponentImplementation(StatusBadgeApi, StatusBadgeComponent)],
);

bootstrapApplication(AppComponent, {
  providers: [provideA2UI({catalogs: [new BasicCatalog(), statusCatalog]})],
});
```

#### SwiftUI

```swift
import A2UICore
import A2UISwiftUI
import BasicCatalogSwiftUI
import JSONSchema
import SwiftUI

let statusBadgeSchema = try! Schema(
  instance: """
    {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "component": { "const": "StatusBadge" },
        "label": { "$ref": "#/$defs/DynamicString" },
        "status": { "type": "string", "enum": ["info", "success", "warning"] }
      },
      "required": ["component", "label", "status"],
      "$defs": { "DynamicString": { "type": ["string", "object"] } }
    }
    """
)

@MainActor
let statusBadge = ComponentImplementation(
  api: AnyComponentAPI(name: "StatusBadge", schema: statusBadgeSchema)
) { node in
  let status = node.string(for: "status") ?? "info"
  let label = node.string(for: "label") ?? ""
  return Text("\(status.uppercased()): \(label)").font(.caption).bold()
}

@MainActor
let statusCatalog = Catalog(
  id: "https://example.com/catalogs/status/v1/catalog.json",
  protocolVersion: .v10,
  components: [statusBadge]
)

@MainActor
let processor = MessageProcessor(
  catalogs: [
    BasicCatalogImplementation.makeCatalog(version: .v10),
    statusCatalog,
  ]
)
```

#### Jetpack Compose

```kotlin
import android.content.Context

import androidx.a2ui.compose.runtime.A2uiComponentProperties
import androidx.a2ui.compose.runtime.A2uiComponentScope
import androidx.a2ui.compose.runtime.A2uiMessageProcessor
import androidx.a2ui.compose.runtime.A2uiProperty
import androidx.a2ui.compose.ui.A2uiCatalog
import androidx.a2ui.compose.ui.A2uiComponent
import androidx.a2ui.compose.ui.catalog.A2uiBasicCatalogV1
import androidx.a2ui.model.processor.A2uiMessageProcessor
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.padding
import androidx.compose.material3.MaterialTheme
```
